verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training controls are a fair privacy question for a payments platform that processes merchant and shopper data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no opt-out or setting that keeps a merchant's data out of model training. It only says Adyen's fraud detection and Uplift use machine learning trained on global transaction data, which points toward data being used for training rather than any way to prevent it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
